method: Isolated headless Edge with frozen production build and intercepted artificial GET fixture; no running inference/API service, user browser profile, or actual result changes.
limitations: UI verification only. All classes, defect percentages and maps in this fixture are artificial controls, not model predictions or proof of grading accuracy.
checks: Latest-run raw class totals include all three partial classes and retain unmapped records as Review.
All three partial classes pass their raw class filter and show the partial label, provisional note, surface percentage and longitude in the drawer.
A complete grade keeps its normal label without a partial note; the unmapped record alone appears in Needs review.
All saved runs counts partial classes correctly; 390px mobile layout has no horizontal overflow.
